court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Smt. Sumanbai Wd/O Trymbakrao & 4 Ors vs Smt. Gangabai Tryambakrao Katre & 2 Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Sumanbai wd/o Trymbakrao Katre, Vijay s/o Trymbakrao Katre, Ku. Reena d/o Trymbakrao Katre, Sau. Jaishree Ganeshrao Nawalkar, Sau. Neeta Nandkishor Kharate
parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Gangabai Tryambakrao Katre, Ku. Kirti Tryambakrao Katre, Ku. Kanchan Tryambakrao Katre

facts_of_case: The parties are referred as per their status before the trial Court. This is a suit for partition and separate possession which came to be decreed in favour of plaintiff Nos. 2 and 3 by judgment and decree dated 04/08/2005.

legal_principles.principle: Legitimate children of a void marriage are entitled to have their shares in the properties left by their parents.
legal_principles.held: Plaintiff Nos. 2 and 3, being legitimate children of deceased Tryambakrao as per Section 16 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, are entitled to have their shares in the properties left by deceased Tryambakrao.

legal_principles.principle: The property rights of legitimate children out of void marriage are conferred by Section 16(3) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

outcome.final_order: The concurrent judgments and decree of both the Courts below are upheld.
